title: Europe’s rights court clears way to return more asylum seekers to Belarus, after pressure from nine governments
lede: On Tuesday, a ruling by the European Court of Human rights made it easier to deport able-bodied adults whenever they are being used to by hostile states like Belarus to stoke tensions. The ruling came after nine EU states complained about the Strasbourg-based court.

title: US court denies ISS bid to dismiss SEC subpoena on client votes
lede: Proxy adviser required to disclosure vote-by-vote data after district court rejects First Amendment defence.
